q: What is the most important thing you learned these days?
a: One of the most important things I have learned recently is that maintaining a positive mindset has a strong impact on my daily life. Even when things do not go as planned, focusing on the positive side from a stoic perspective helps me stay motivated and look for solutions instead of problems. I have also realized that positivity is contagious, and staying calm and optimistic creates a more constructive and supportive atmosphere around me.
